info.title: Vairas Authentication API
info.description: Global identity, verified local credentials, browser-bound external OIDC login/link, sessions and scoped workload tokens. No profiles or school roles are created. Registration/challenge acknowledgments do not disclose account existence. User access tokens last at most 15 minutes; refresh tokens rotate once. Email links are delivered asynchronously through SMTP.

post.summary: Begin a configured external OIDC login or an authenticated explicit link.
post.description: Requires a Secure HttpOnly browser correlation cookie. The frontend forwards code/state by JSON POST after the allowlisted provider redirect. Link additionally requires a currently active user bearer session. Transactions are single-use and expire after ten minutes; matching email never authorizes linking.

post.summary: Revoke an owned session using a stable idempotency key.
post.description: Only the identity's own sessions. Successful and authenticated not-found outcomes retain the key binding; changed target/identity conflicts. A completed self-logout can replay its saved receipt with the original still-unexpired JWT; this exception authorizes no other action.

post.summary: Obtain a scoped workload token for an allowlisted service client.
post.description: Internal client_credentials or explicitly enabled RFC 8693 ReadPreviewV1 exchange. Exchange requires subject_token/access-token type, one configured resource, school_id and a subset of read/preview scopes. Only chat-backend -> MCP -> owner is permitted; ConfirmedLessonActionsV1 additionally requires its separate enable switch and exact lesson_action binding; its second hop targets Scheduling only. No refresh token grant. Exchange success additionally returns issued_token_type. Never publish this endpoint through Gateway.
